normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only consumed to set the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
supply is only used to initialize the token supply during construction.
addresses is only iterated during the constructor distribution loop.
the constructor tokens array drives the initial distribution amounts.
freezeList is only copied into the freezeUntil mapping in the constructor.
ignoreList only populates the ignoreDividend mapping in the constructor.
tokenOwner is only used as the lookup key in balanceOf.
the from parameter drives the linked list scan in requireTrade.
to is only the credited recipient inside transfer.
spender is only the allowance key written by approve.
data is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
addr selects the external token contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
percentage is the dividend scale factor consumed by giveDividend.
enabled is only written into the readOnly flag.
totalAddresses is a loop bound local of the constructor only.
totalTokens is a length check local of the constructor only.
aggregateTokens accumulates distributed amounts only in the constructor.
the constructor loop index exists only for the distribution loops.
addrs is the memory result array assembled solely by list.
tokensLocal is the memory result array assembled solely by list.
the list cursor tracks traversal of addressLinkedList only inside list.
timestamp caches freezeUntil inside the requireTrade loop.
found caches the ignoreDividend lookup inside giveDividend.
extraTokens is the direct result of the unchecked dividend multiplication.
parent holds the predecessor node used for unlinking in removeFromAccountList.
